title: CloudPricingOps Optimization Request
description: Defines the workload requirements submitted by the Visualization Interface to the Optimization Engine. This initial contract supports a single Compute instance workload.

regionGroup.title: Region group
regionGroup.description: Geographical region group in which the workload should be deployed. Values correspond to RegionGroup in the canonical pricing schema.

operatingSystem.title: Operating system
operatingSystem.description: Required operating system for the workload. The value is matched against the OperatingSystem field of the pricing catalog.

pricingCategory.title: Pricing category
pricingCategory.description: Pricing model to consider when selecting eligible SKUs.

hoursPerMonth.title: Hours per month
hoursPerMonth.description: Expected monthly operating hours used for estimating the workload cost.

components.title: Workload components
components.description: Components defining the workload to optimize. The initial mock contract supports exactly one Compute instance.

ServiceCategory.title: Service category
ServiceCategory.description: Canonical ServiceCategory of the requested cloud service.

PriceComponent.title: Price component
PriceComponent.description: Canonical PriceComponent used to identify the charge being compared.

PricingUnit.title: Pricing unit
PricingUnit.description: Canonical pricing unit used for this workload.

quantity.title: Quantity
quantity.description: Number of identical instances required by the workload.

minVCpu.title: Minimum vCPU
minVCpu.description: Minimum number of vCPUs required per instance.

minMemoryGiB.title: Minimum memory (GiB)
minMemoryGiB.description: Minimum RAM capacity required per instance, measured in GiB.
